fullDescription: A high-end cinematic creative agency style guide featuring a dark-mode palette with vibrant orange accents. Optimized for premium digital studios, portfolios, and high-tech product launches. Key elements include full-screen video backgrounds, glassmorphism UI components, bold editorial typography (Inter), and minimalist layout structures with heavy letter-spacing for taglines.

structured.summary: A premium 'cinematic' design system for creative agencies, characterized by dark backgrounds (#0a0a0a), high-contrast orange highlights (#ff5e00), and sophisticated glassmorphism effects. The layout utilizes full-viewport video backgrounds and minimalist typography to convey a sense of 'future-proof' luxury.

style.description: The style essence combines a brutalist typography approach with sleek modern glass effects. Typography uses 'Inter' exclusively, ranging from ultra-bold headers (72px) to tiny, wide-spaced caps for metadata. The color palette is strictly dark (deep blacks and grays) to let the primary orange accent and video content stand out.
style.prompt: Create a design system using a base background of #0a0a0a and an accent color of #ff5e00. Use 'Inter' as the primary font family. Titles should be bold/extrabold with tight letter-spacing (-0.05em), while sub-labels and taglines should use 10px font size with 0.4em tracking in uppercase. Implement glassmorphism using 'backdrop-filter: blur(12px)' and semi-transparent white borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)). Animation style: smooth 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' transitions for hover states and a subtle floating 'Y-axis' animation for icons. Button hover effects should involve a color shift to rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.2) with a 32px glow shadow.

layout_and_structure.description: Full-bleed immersive layout with a fixed floating navigation bar and a content-heavy services section below the fold.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top navigation bar centered with a max-width of 1400px. The container should be fully rounded (rounded-full), featuring a subtle blur (12px) and a transparent background. Logo on the left (16px font-size, extrabold), nav links in the center (14px, medium), and a glassmorphism CTA button on the right. Spacing: 32px horizontal padding, 16px vertical padding.

Full-height (100vh) hero section with a background video (object-cover). Apply a linear-gradient overlay from rgba(10,10,10,0.3) at the top to rgba(10,10,10,0.5) at the bottom for text legibility. Content is left-aligned: small uppercase tagline (10px, 0.4em spacing) followed by a massive header (72px, font-extrabold, line-height 1). Below the header, a muted description paragraph (18px, color: white/60) with a max-width of 450px. Two rounded-full glass buttons sit side-by-side at the bottom of the stack.

Absolute-positioned UI elements at the bottom of the hero. Left side: location/brand info in 11px font size with white/40 opacity. Right side: dynamic year/stat and a 40x40px circular button containing a floating arrow icon. The border of the circle should be white/20.

Section with #0a0a0a background and 128px vertical padding. Use a 2-column grid layout. Column 1: A small horizontal orange bar (48px wide) above a massive 5xl heading. Column 2: Horizontal list of numbered tags (e.g., 01 / Branding) in white/40 opacity, followed by a body paragraph (18px) with 1.6 line-height.

special_ui_components.description: A semi-transparent button that blurs the background content.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a button with: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). On hover: background becomes rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.2), border color changes to rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.4), and a box-shadow of 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.1) is applied.

Create a 40x40px circle with a 1px border of white/20. Inside, place a center-aligned arrow icon. Apply a CSS keyframe animation 'float' that moves the icon translateY(0px) to translateY(-10px) over 3 seconds with an ease-in-out timing function, looping infinitely.

structured.special_notes:
MUST maintain high contrast between text and video background using the dark gradient overlay. MUST-NOT use vibrant colors other than #ff5e00. Letter-spacing is critical: negative for headings (-0.05em), very wide for taglines (0.4em). All interactive elements must have the 12px blur filter for consistent glassmorphism.
